summary: Frontend-only e2e test of the 'AI Parse Corrections' machine-alias feature in the Dealer Parts Allocation Wizard (owner@isodemo.com, org iso-demo-org). All 3 requested flows PASSED: (1) Step-1 'Find in BOM' picker maps an unmatched typed ref, shows the green matched state and BOTH toasts ('Matched to <ref>' + 'Remembered — “QATESTREF1” will map to 220G-AAW automatically next time.'); (2) REMEMBER/AUTO-RESOLVE — a brand-new allocation typing only 'QATESTREF1' generated a recommendation with UNMATCHED LINES = 0 and a full pack (£494, 15 parts, machine 220G-AAW) i.e. the backend resolved it via the stored alias; (3) STEP-2 UNMATCHED RESOLVER — 'QATESTREF2' produced the amber dp-wiz-unmatched-warning box listing the ref with a working dp-wiz-unmatched-find-QATESTREF2 button; picking a BOM machine saved the alias and AUTO-REGENERATED the recommendation (unmatched 1 -> 0, pack £0 -> £494, consolidated parts table rendered). Alias persistence independently confirmed via GET /api/dealer-parts/data/machine-aliases (2 rows, no MongoDB _id leaked).

design_issues.screen: Service Desk shell (all Dealer Parts tabs)
issues: Pre-existing React console error on every render: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option> ... ServiceDesk...:477' (hydration warning). Not caused by this feature but noisy; the dealer <select> options should render plain text.

action_items: CLEANUP REQUIRED — delete the 2 throwaway aliases created by this test in org iso-demo-org via DELETE /api/dealer-parts/data/machine-aliases/{id}: QATESTREF1 -> 220G-AAW (id 4f6eec99-930b-4ebb-9dbf-45caa188039d) and QATESTREF2 -> 220G-AAW (id 9b76a609-2409-40d4-b438-18317386a8fa).
Optional: fix the <span> inside <option> hydration warning in ServiceDesk (line ~477).
FYI: the BOM machine '220G-AAA' named in the test brief does NOT exist in iso-demo-org (searching '220' returns 220G-AAW/AAT/ABC/AAS/ABA/AAQ/AAR/AAZ). Test used 220G-AAW instead.
critical_code_review_comments: resolveUnmatched() awaits createMachineAlias then calls generate(); generate() re-reads `lines` from state, which still holds the original unmatched ref — correct, and it worked. But the 'Remembered — … Updating recommendation…' toast was already gone by the time the regenerate finished in my run; consider keeping an inline 'Re-checking BOM…' indicator on the amber box while generate() runs so the user isn't left with a stale unmatched panel.

pickMachine() overwrites the visible machine_ref input with the BOM ref and only keeps the typed ref in a hidden `input_ref` field — fine, but generate() sends machine_ref only, so if the alias POST fails (swallowed by the empty catch) the user gets no feedback that the mapping was NOT remembered. Consider a non-blocking warning toast in that catch.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 machine aliases in org iso-demo-org (QATESTREF1, QATESTREF2 -> 220G-AAW). No allocations were approved/created (stopped at the Recommendation review step every time).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Route: /service-desk -> desk-tab-stores -> desk-stores-sub-dealer -> click text 'Allocation Wizard'. A cookie banner overlays the bottom of the page on first load — click 'Accept All' before interacting with dp-wiz-generate. /api/auth/login is rate-limited so run the whole flow in ONE browser session. Valid BOM machine refs in iso-demo-org start with '220G-AA*'; '220G-AAA' does not exist.
rca_of_the_issue: No defects found. The only observation is cosmetic (toast lifetime vs regenerate duration) and a pre-existing unrelated hydration warning.
